title: Logistic regression on frozen DINOv3 features for anomaly tags (pixltagger)
body: In the separate tagger-training repo, a class-balanced logistic regression (StandardScaler, C = 0.1) was fitted on frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16 features using thousands of in-house labels for extra limb, malformed hand, malformed foot and bad anatomy, and compared with fine-tuned models.
